rows.grounds: genitive plural compound śivādi with indeclinable ca and genitive plural devānām; sandhi/fusion kept as given
locative singular of compound dvāra-dakṣiṇa indicating position relative to the door

items.question: On which side of the door are Śiva and other deities to be situated?
premises: The verse refers to Śiva and other gods.
The verse also refers to the goddesses.
The verse specifies the southern side of the door.
items.inference: Śiva, other gods, and the goddesses are to be situated on the southern side of the door.
uncertainties: The exact ritual action implied by the locative is supplied from the preceding context of placement.
items.plain_english: Śiva and the other gods, and the goddesses, are to be placed on the southern side of the door.
